text:
U.S. stock markets are trading in a mixed, cautious fashion today as investors weigh rising energy prices against anticipation for major technology earnings. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 have seen modest gains, the Nasdaq Composite has faced pressure, reflecting a broader "wait-and-see" approach ahead of results from Alphabet and Tesla.

Energy and utilities are leading sector gains, supported by a surge in crude oil prices driven by geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Conversely, technology and communication services are lagging as the market evaluates the sustainability of AI-related capital expenditures and reacts to the inflationary impact of higher energy costs.
